features.name: Quality Management Extension
features.description: A new extension that allows companies to install quality management capabilities to comply with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Enables automatic and manual quality inspections at various points in the business process.

features.name: Automatic Quality Test Triggering
features.description: Quality tests can be triggered automatically when specific events happen in the system, such as receiving goods or checking produced output. No manual intervention needed for these automated triggers.

features.name: Scheduled Quality Inspections
features.description: Quality inspections can be scheduled to run on a recurring basis, such as periodic rechecking of goods to ensure quality has not degraded over time.

features.name: Manual Quality Test Triggering
features.description: Users can manually trigger inspection when receiving input from external or internal sources indicating potential quality issues, allowing proactive quality stops and checks.

features.name: Flexible Quality Configuration
features.description: The quality management solution is highly configurable to accommodate different business practices and industry-specific quality processes that vary by organization, vendor, or product group.

features.name: Automated Non-Compliant Item Handling
features.description: Different options are available to automatically handle items discovered to be non-compliant as a result of quality checks.

features.name: Quality Inspection on Purchase Receipt
features.description: When goods are received as part of a purchase order, a quality inspection can be automatically created to verify the quality of the received items before they enter inventory.
caveats: Inspection notifications are shown in the demo but may not be displayed to receipt posting users in real implementations

features.name: Quality Test Execution with Multiple Test Types
features.description: Quality inspections support multiple test types that can be performed on items, with values entered in a test value column. Tests include structured options like pass/fail buttons and dropdown selections from predefined lists.
caveats: Demo shows multiple UI patterns for test entry including assist-edit popups and dropdown lists

features.name: Test Result Descriptions and Guidance
features.description: Quality tests can include past and failed descriptions that provide hints to inspectors about what values constitute passing versus failing results, with support for additional comments and notes on individual tests.

features.name: Inspection Result Determination
features.description: A single failed test is sufficient to mark the entire inspection as failed. The overall inspection result is determined by evaluating all test results.

features.name: Document Attachments in Inspections
features.description: Users can attach images and other documents to quality inspections to visually document inspection findings and conditions.
caveats: Can take pictures directly from device or drag and drop pre-prepared images

features.name: Automatic Transfer Order for Non-Compliant Items
features.description: When a quality inspection fails, the system automatically creates a transfer order to move the non-compliant items to a designated location, based on the sample size tested.
caveats: Transfer quantity corresponds to sample size tested, not total received quantity

features.name: Item Tracking Preservation in Quality Process
features.description: Item tracking information such as lot numbers is preserved and passed correctly throughout the quality inspection and subsequent transfer order processes.

features.name: Sample Size Configuration in Quality Inspections
features.description: Quality inspections support configurable sample sizes, allowing inspectors to test a subset of received items rather than the entire quantity received.

features.name: Sales Blocking by Quality Inspection Failures
features.description: Sales transactions are automatically blocked when items have a failed quality inspection result for the specific lot or item tracking, preventing shipment of non-compliant items.

features.name: Quality Inspection Recreation and Rechecking
features.description: Users can create additional quality inspections for the remaining untested quantity of items to recheck quality if initial samples failed.
caveats: Can be performed to test remaining quantity after initial sample inspection

features.name: Certificate of Analysis Document
features.description: An external-facing quality document that shows what was tested, who performed the test, and the inspection results, which can be attached to documents and communicated externally.
caveats: Layout is under revision and will be different in the actual release

features.name: Non-Conformance Report
features.description: A quality document that shows detailed information about each test performed, including who registered the test, date and time of execution, and individual test details for non-conforming items.

features.name: Quality Management Role Center
features.description: A specialized role center for quality management users that includes demo tools with step-by-step guidance for setup, configuration, and product usage.
caveats: Not expected to be used by default according to speaker

features.name: Quality Management Setup Data
features.description: Setup data for quality management is installed automatically with the extension in an isolated manner without impact on other functionality. Demo data can optionally be installed through Contoso demo tool.
caveats: Safe to install as data is isolated; number series are created automatically

features.name: Inspection Results Configuration
features.description: Configure possible outcomes for inspections with multiple states beyond pass/fail, including not started, in progress, failed, and passed. Organizations can customize states to capture nuances like passing with reservations.
caveats: Default provides only three states but can be extended

features.name: Result Visibility Settings
features.description: Control where inspection results are displayed through promoted or configuration-only settings. Promoted results appear in multiple places including inspection forms and printed documents.

features.name: Item Tracking Inspection Controls
features.description: Block transactions based on inspection status of items with lot or item tracking information. Allows selective blocking by transaction type, such as preventing sales of items with failed inspections while allowing other transactions.
caveats: Blocking is configurable per transaction type
Users can set different rules for sales, consumption, and other transactions

features.name: Quality Test Parameters
features.description: Define quality test measurements for different product attributes such as temperature, size, and other parameters. Tests are configured as fields supporting multiple data types including decimals, integers, booleans, dates, options, and table lookups.
caveats: Multiple data types support different measurement scenarios

features.name: Allowable Values and Validation
features.description: Define acceptable value ranges for test parameters to prevent invalid entries. The system rejects values outside specified ranges, such as preventing percentage values outside 0-100 range.
caveats: Values outside allowable ranges are rejected by the system

features.name: Default Test Values
features.description: Optionally specify default values for test parameters to reduce inspector effort. However, using default values prevents system from registering who performed the test and when.
caveats: Using defaults prevents audit trail of who performed the test
Lines will not be updated if inspectors do not modify default values

features.name: Result Conditions and Pass-Fail Logic
features.description: Specify conditions that determine whether test results pass or fail. Each test can have multiple conditions evaluated in sequence, with evaluation order determining the final result when multiple conditions apply.
caveats: When multiple conditions apply, evaluation sequence determines which takes precedence
Can be complex to configure properly to avoid conflicting conditions

features.name: Evaluation Sequence
features.description: Control the priority order in which pass and fail conditions are evaluated. Higher evaluation sequence takes precedence when multiple conditions apply to the same test result.
caveats: Requires careful configuration to avoid unintended result determinations

features.name: Boolean Test Type
features.description: Use Boolean field type for checklist-based quality tests where inspectors confirm yes or no for specific attributes. Provides clear pass and fail conditions with optional default values.

features.name: Option Type Tests
features.description: Use option data type to provide a predefined list of allowed values for quality tests. Similar to AL development option fields, allowing selection from comma-separated values.

features.name: Table Lookup for Test Values
features.description: Configure quality tests to use table lookup allowing selection from any Business Central table data. Enables dynamic value selection with filtering capabilities and field selection configuration.
caveats: Must specify which field to use for display rather than primary key
Requires careful setup to ensure appropriate data

features.name: Lookup Filtering and Field Selection
features.description: Apply filters to table lookups to restrict available values, and select which table field to display. Filters use standard Business Central filtering syntax to limit selections to relevant records.
caveats: Can produce very large result sets requiring performance management

features.name: Lookup Performance Limits
features.description: Enforce lookup result limits to prevent performance degradation when browsing large datasets. The quality management setup controls maximum row count returned in lookups.
caveats: Result limit is configurable but may require adjustments based on scenario

features.name: Quality Lookup Values Table
features.description: Built-in table storing predefined values for quality test lookups. Automatically populated when table lookup is configured, organized by lookup code and linked to specific quality tests.

features.name: Quality Test Lookup Values
features.description: Automatically linked lookup values for quality tests, populated through allowable values interface or manual entry into the quality test lookup values table.

features.name: Quality Test Types
features.description: Multiple test types supported including integer, decimal, date, text, option lookup, and boolean for different selection and measurement scenarios.

features.name: Quality Templates
features.description: Collection of different quality tests organized into templates with support for sampling size definitions and separator labels for document printing.
caveats: Separator entry type only works for document organization and does not perform validation

features.name: Sampling Configuration
features.description: Sampling size can be defined as fixed quantity or percent of quantity, with automatic rounding to integers only.
caveats: Only integers allowed for calculated sample quantities

features.name: Inspection Generation Rules
features.description: Rules that define when quality templates are automatically used, supporting purchase and sales scenarios with configurable line-level conditions based on location, quantity, item tracking, and other field filters.
caveats: Item tracking code limitations affect certain quality result operations
Different triggers apply to different document types

features.name: Automatic Inspection Creation
features.description: Inspections can be created manually or automatically based on inspection generation rules tied to business events like purchase order received or sales return receipt.
caveats: Different events apply for different document types
Job queue option available for scheduled recurring inspections

features.name: Quality Inspection Results Blocking
features.description: Quality inspection results can block sales, purchases, and consumption operations, but only for items with item tracking code defined.
caveats: Blocking limitations only apply to items with item tracking code
Alternative blocking methods needed for items without tracking

features.name: Quality Management Setup
features.description: Quality management setup page with default values for inspection triggers and number series configuration. Preinstalled in new 2026 wave one environments, installable via app source for existing customers.
caveats: Preinstalled only for new environments in 2026 wave one
Existing customers must install from app source
Only number series is a shared table between installations

features.name: Inspection Actions for Non-Conforming Items
features.description: Multiple actions available for failed or passed inspections including inventory movement via reclassification, transfer orders, negative adjustments, purchase returns, and item tracking changes.
caveats: Reopen and deletion actions limited to quality management administrators
Quantity selection options include full quantity, specified quantity, sample quantity or failed/pass quantity

features.name: Item Tracking Change in Quality Management
features.description: Users can change item tracking details such as lot number or expiration dates during quality inspection processes, allowing flexible tracking number management.

features.name: Quantity Selection Options in Quality Inspections
features.description: Quality inspectors can specify which quantity to use when triggering adjustments: full quantity, a manually specified quantity, sample quantity, failed quantity, or pass quantity.

features.name: Sample Quantity Field in Quality Management
features.description: A separate sample quantity field is available in quality management, currently hidden by default but accessible.
caveats: currently hidden

features.name: Quality Inspection Workflow Events
features.description: Four built-in quality inspection related workflow events are available: quality inspection created, changed, finished, and reopened. These events trigger automatic workflow actions based on configured conditions.

features.name: Workflow Conditions for Quality Inspections
features.description: Workflow rules can be configured with conditions such as finished status, specific items, or locations. Conditions determine when workflow responses execute based on inspection results.

features.name: Tracking Number Blocking Workflow Response
features.description: Workflow can automatically block tracking numbers when quality inspection starts and unblock them upon finishing based on inspection results.

features.name: Quality Inspection Action Workflows
features.description: Built-in workflow actions for quality inspections include recreating inspection, finishing inspection, and reopening inspection based on configured conditions.

features.name: Inventory Movement Workflow Responses
features.description: Workflow can trigger various inventory movements as responses to quality inspection results including negative adjustment, internal put-away, purchase return, transfer order, and move inventory from inspection.

features.name: Quality Management API Integration
features.description: Quality management events and responses are exposed through API, allowing integration with external tools like Power Automate while supporting internal workflow automation.

features.name: Built-in Quality Management Workflows
features.description: Quality management includes built-in workflow automation for simple, non-approval scenarios that execute within the same transaction. These are simpler to configure than approval workflows and do not require external orchestration.
caveats: best for simple activities not requiring human involvement
not suitable for approval/notification scenarios
